contexts.text: The cessations of cupidities and falsities...
Shall not cease () = in all time.
There first ceases to be an inhabitant on the Earth when there is no longer any Church...
Under Cause, see these references. AC 571 1.
Action... would cease in a moment, for... when endeavour ceases, motion ceases.
A prediction that the internal of the Church would cease, Signified. To die = to cease to be such, thus to cease.
When the good of charity ceases, the Church ceases.
She ceased from him () = permission to represent.
Ye make them cease from their burdens () = that they have not infested enough.
To cease () = the end of that state.
Cease from us that we may serve the Egyptians () = that they would not be withheld from giving themselves up.
Temptations cease...
Cessation () = indemnification.
To cease from removing () = not to instruct and amend.
On the seventh day thou shalt cease () = the state of good when in internals, and the quiet of peace then... To cease, or rest from works = the quiet of peace then.
When will ceases, action ceases.
The total cessation of the heart...
If you take away will from act, work ceases; or if you take away thought from speech, speech ceases; or if you take away endeavour from motion, motion ceases.
The evil wild beasts shall cease () = that there would be no evil affections and concupiscences... AE 388:7. AE 650:51. AE 701:18.
Vastation as to Knowledges of good is described by, I will make the noise of thy songs to cease (). AE 326:7.
Make the Holy One of Israel to cease from our faces () = the Lord, from thought and affection...
To wash = to remove falsities and evils, therefore it is said... Cease to do evil ().
Desolation is described by the ways ceased... the broad places in Israel ceased ().
